info.description: G2 public read APIs are implemented behind the default-disabled PUBLIC_BROWSING_ENABLED release gate.

x-semantic-rules: Current source/author/company/project/moderation eligibility before projection and pagination
Public-safe comment authors and parent thread context
Category-specific filters and exact compensation units
Matching resource IDs, paths, response scope and entry/comment ownership
No private portfolio tokens in discovery
No exposure/history/analytics writes for guest reads
